name: anim_trio_sink3
subject: a melting mound of pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks on a goo puddle
desc: Like melting wax or hot slime, the soft mound keeps oozing and slumping down, spreading outward in lumpy wavy shapes with drips and stretchy strands, the outline always soft, round and irregular, until it has melted completely into a wide, thin, flat puddle on the floor. Never a straight or flat cut edge on top.
